geometryNotes: Corner towers/grass ornament in generated ground atlas are excluded from flat pavement inner quads.
Source lane paints are geometrically normalized to edge midpoints, not diamond vertices.
Taxi graph marks are UV-remapped actual native yellow paint over actual apron material; no code strokes.
limitations: Shared jade terminal/administration/transceiver modules are functional visual redesigns, not pixel copies of every original terminal fragment or circular geometry.
Airport whole-layout PNGs are actual full-footprint art assembly previews; they are not icons or Unity/runtime scene proof.
APRON source taxi sprite names have an explicit equivalent centre graph; exact traffic pathfinding/collision remains source data and next-phase work.

knownRepresentationAssumptions: Same terminal/admin architecture reused for multiple compatible source tiles; not distinct original pixel structures.
Taxi paths use a normalized equivalent centre graph. Exact vehicle motion alignment remains a Unity integration check.
Radar is an elevation scan sweep from a painted dish, not a native360 yaw movie. Wind cloth is a premultiplied warp; all20frames are deterministic derivatives.
Oilrig airport shares its industry body;3x3water in preview is surrounding context, not airport logical footprint.
